title: fix: add endpoint agent request example
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds the missing JSON body to the generated Endpoint Agent POST example.
- Fixes the API-reference validator failure after production deployment.
- Keeps generated APIDOCS.md out of the feature PR.

Validation:
- Biome
- Gen typecheck

The live docs workflow will pass after this sample reaches Gen production.

gist.headline: The POST got its pollen
gist.blurb: The Endpoint Agent example was sending visitors toward a POST request with no body. It now carries the JSON payload it was always meant to bring.
gist.summary: Added the missing JSON request body to the generated Endpoint Agent POST example in Gen's API documentation, allowing the production API-reference validator to pass.
gist.impact: Developers now get a complete Endpoint Agent POST sample they can copy into a working request, and the live docs can validate successfully after deployment.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy API garden workbench where Polli is delivering a small labeled JSON parcel into a retro terminal's POST-request mailbox. The terminal shows a neat Endpoint Agent request, with code-plants and flowers growing around it to represent documentation becoming usable; Polli wears a tiny courier cap.

Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, chunky retro sprites, subtle CRT glow, pixel-font text "JSON READY", lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
